info.title: ShellFans Public Read-Only API
info.summary: The small set of unauthenticated read-only endpoints that ShellFans intentionally exposes.
info.description:
ShellFans (唄粉智能科技股份有限公司 / ShellFans AI Technology) is a Taiwan company operating two service lines: AEO/GEO managed hosting, and cross-platform social media asset continuity.

**Scope of this document.** It describes only endpoints that are (a) already publicly reachable without credentials, (b) read-only, (c) free of personal data, and (d) intended to be consumed by third parties. Everything else ShellFans runs — the chat pipeline, the administrative API, the customer console, payment webhooks — is deliberately absent. Their absence is documented at https://shell.fans/developers rather than implied.

**There is no write API.** No endpoint here creates, modifies or deletes anything. ShellFans cannot be driven as a tool to perform work on a user's behalf. Requests using POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE will not succeed.

**No authentication is required or accepted.** There is no OAuth authorization server, no API keys for public consumers, and no scopes. Sending an Authorization header has no effect on these endpoints.

**Stability.** These endpoints back ShellFans' own public website, so they are stable in practice, but they carry no formal versioning or deprecation policy. Content fields are editorial and change without notice; treat their text as data, not as a contract.

get.description: Reports whether the ShellFans chat backend is accepting requests. Use this to decide whether shell.fans is reachable before attempting anything else. Always returns 200 when the service is up; a non-200 or a connection failure means it is not.

get.summary: Remaining anonymous query allowance for the caller
get.description:
Returns how many free ShellFans Chat queries the calling IP address has left today. The allowance is per-IP and resets daily.

This endpoint is informational only — it reports the allowance, it does not grant, reserve or consume it. There is no public endpoint for spending the allowance: ShellFans Chat is only callable from the website's own interface. An agent should read this to explain the limit to a user, not to plan automated calls.

200.description: Current allowance for the calling IP address.

get.summary: Which ShellFans service lines are currently offered
get.description:
Returns one boolean per service line, reflecting whether ShellFans is currently selling it. The public website hides navigation entries for lines that are off.

Read this before telling a user that a ShellFans service is available — a line can be archived without its marketing pages being removed. A `false` value means the service is not currently being sold, regardless of what other pages say.

get.summary: Published plan tiers and the feature comparison table
get.description:
Returns the plan cards and comparison table exactly as rendered on https://shell.fans/pricing.

Amounts are in New Taiwan Dollars. A card whose `cta` is not a purchase call-to-action indicates a tier that is announced but not yet purchasable — do not quote it as available. Always cross-check `getProductAvailability` before telling a user a plan can be bought.

get.summary: Company identity block and site-wide footer links
get.description:
Returns the footer content shared by every ShellFans page: legal entity name, registered address, contact details, Taiwan unified business number, patent notices, official social profiles, and the footer link groups.

This is the authoritative machine-readable source for ShellFans' corporate identity. All strings are bilingual objects keyed `zh-TW` and `en`. The same facts appear as Schema.org Organization / PostalAddress / ContactPoint JSON-LD on every page of https://shell.fans.

Returns the content rendered at https://shell.fans/co-founder: the founder's biography and the dated company milestones (incorporation, the Tokyo entity, and the Taiwan and US patent grants).

Useful for entity resolution — confirming that a ShellFans reference on the open web corresponds to this specific Taiwan company. Biography and milestone bodies contain a restricted set of inline HTML.

NotFound.description: No such endpoint. ShellFans does not expose an API surface beyond the operations in this document.

error.message: The requested endpoint does not exist.
error.hint: Public endpoints are described at https://shell.fans/openapi.json. Administrative routes are not public.

Error.description: Every machine-oriented error response from ShellFans uses this envelope.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Branch on this, not on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording is not stable.

hint.description: Where to look next. Present on most errors.

ok.description: True when the service is accepting requests. Never false in a 200 response.

ts.description: Server time in ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

remaining.description: Free queries left today for the calling IP address.

limit.description: Daily allowance for the calling IP address.

resetAt.description: When the allowance resets, as Unix milliseconds.

anonymous.description: True when the caller is not an authenticated ShellFans user. Always true for public callers.

searchable_platforms.description: Social platforms the caller's tier may query. Public callers get the anonymous set.

shellfans_endurance_engine_enabled.description: Cross-platform social media asset continuity (ShellFans 續航引擎).

kolfans_wom_enabled.description: Word-of-mouth marketing workflow platform (口碑行銷).

LocalizedText.description: A string in both supported locales.

slug.description: Stable identifier for the plan. Use this to correlate across responses, not `name`.

tier.description: Tier family the plan belongs to.

popular.description: Whether the plan is highlighted as the recommended choice.

cta.description: Call-to-action label. A non-purchase label (for example 敬請期待 / coming soon) means the plan is announced but not purchasable.

prices.description: Billing periods offered for this plan. Absent when the plan has no published price.

features.description: Feature list shown on the card.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. TWD unless stated otherwise.

columns.description: Column headers, aligned with the plan cards.

sections.description: Feature groups. Each row's `value` array is positionally aligned with `columns`.

company.description: Legal entity block: company name, registered address, email, phone, Taiwan unified business number.

patent.description: Patent notice. Covers the social media maintenance technology only — ShellFans claims no AEO or GEO patent.

social.description: Official ShellFans profiles. These are the same URLs published as Organization.sameAs.

intro.description: Biography. `bodyHtml` contains a restricted set of inline HTML.
